name: Le Royal Meridien Shanghai
insider_take: This sleek tower rises 66 floors above Shanghai's bustling Nanjing Road, offering a sophisticated retreat in the heart of China's financial powerhouse.
whats_special: The hotel sits directly on Nanjing Road, one of the world's busiest shopping streets, and features panoramic views of the Huangpu River and iconic Bund skyline. Its Art Deco-inspired design pays homage to Shanghai's 1930s golden era while delivering ultra-modern luxury.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 40+ for unobstructed views of the Oriental Pearl Tower and request evening turndown service to enjoy the neon-lit cityscape at its most spectacular.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature afternoon tea service with views overlooking People's Square, and take the short walk to the historic Bund waterfront promenade - especially magical during the 8pm light show when the Pudong skyline illuminates in synchronized colors.
pros: Prime location in People's Square with excellent metro connectivity
Spacious rooms and suites with luxury amenities
Multiple dining venues including rooftop restaurant with city views
Full-service spa and well-equipped fitness center
cons: Busy downtown location may not suit those seeking tranquility
